meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问某条 senpi 提示（比如终端里的 `Tip:` 行）是什么意思时，它会先运行 `senpi --list-tips` 并读取你的设置，确认哪些提示你看得到，再读对应源码，用你的语言给出带具体判定条件和文件路径的解释。
howto.when: 当你询问某条提示的含义、某个被提示的功能如何运作，或你能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思？
say.note: 它会先查实时提示列表再读代码解释

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后出现的提示是干嘛的？
say.note: 它会讲整套 fallback-architect 流程

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些提示？
say.note: 它会结合你的设置说明

howto.what_en: When you ask what a senpi tip means, it runs `senpi --list-tips`, reads your settings to see which tips you can see, reads the matching source, and explains the exact mechanism in your language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.note: It checks the live tip list and reads the code first

say_en.text: What does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal do?
say_en.note: It walks the full fallback-architect pipeline
It answers based on your own settings
